name: Protecting Your Heart
overview: Scripture calls believers to diligently guard their hearts, recognizing that life’s outcomes flow from what the heart holds (Proverbs 4:23). By dwelling in the secret place of the Most High and setting our love upon God, we abide under His protection and receive deliverance (Psalms 91:1,14). A heart fixed on God brings perfect peace and purity, enabling us to see God and resist fleshly desires by walking in the Spirit (Isaiah 26:3; Matthew 5:8; Galatians 5:16). This divine safeguarding of the heart is essential for spiritual vitality and communion with God.
